description:
Compare the out-of-sample predictive performance of two models for US Inflation using the 'usa.gdt' dataset.

1. Estimate an AR(1) model for 'inf' on the training sample 1984:1 to 2005:4.
2. Generate a dynamic forecast for the period 2006:1 to 2009:3.
3. Estimate an AR(4) model for 'inf' on the same training sample.
4. Generate a dynamic forecast for the same forecast period.
5. Calculate the Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) for both forecasts over the 2006:1-2009:3 period.

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/rmse_report.txt' containing:
- The RMSE for the AR(1) model
- The RMSE for the AR(4) model
- Which model performed better (lower RMSE)

metadata.ground_truth_logic: AR(1) and AR(4) RMSE comparison on POE5 USA data
